population: XAUUSD frozen-M7C PRIMARY trades entered at first causal M1 turn using the user-supplied 2023-01-03 through 2026-06-19 multi-timeframe GOLD history

evidence_status.2025: opened during M9M; NOT untouched holdout for M9N hypotheses

baseline.interpretation: Prioritize LONG. SHORT remains structurally weak in 2023-2025 and no simple symmetric regime condition repaired it across all three years.

static_candidate_postmortem.result: M9M static 2023-2024 candidates failed the 2025 sealed holdout
static_candidate_postmortem.cause_pattern: 2025 preserved high win rates but enlarged average losses and loss tails; fixed indicator thresholds were regime-fragile.
static_candidate_postmortem.simple_early_exit_check: M15 bull-stack-break / RCI-negative / MACD-negative fail-safe exits were explored and did not improve PF consistently across 2023-2026; no exit change is promoted.

N1_M5_QUIET_PULLBACK.definition: At the first-turn decision, closed M5 tick_volume_ratio20 <= the rolling 50th percentile of the latest 200 closed M5 bars.
N1_M5_QUIET_PULLBACK.interpretation: A relatively quiet M5 pullback is more stable than a fixed ATR/RCI threshold and preserves useful frequency.

N2_M15_STRONG_MOMENTUM.definition: At the first-turn decision, closed M15 MACD(6,13) line in bps >= the rolling 75th percentile of the latest 200 closed M15 bars.
N2_M15_STRONG_MOMENTUM.interpretation: Strong M15 trend impulse is a second stable route even though its win rate is lower; losses are smaller and PF is stronger.

N3_BROAD_CORE_OR.definition: N1 M5 quiet pullback OR N2 M15 strong momentum.
N3_BROAD_CORE_OR.quarter_warning: 12 of 14 observed quarters clear PF 1.0; 2024Q4 was approximately PF 0.976 and 2025Q3 approximately PF 0.798. This is not a final live rule.

N4_PREMIUM_QUIET_DAILY_AND_M5.definition: Closed D1 body_to_range <= rolling 25th percentile of latest 100 closed D1 bars AND N1 M5 quiet-pullback condition.
N4_PREMIUM_QUIET_DAILY_AND_M5.warning: Low frequency and small subperiod samples. 2026Q2 had only 11 trades and PF about 0.196, so PREMIUM cannot be promoted despite strong aggregate PF.

N5_H4_RCI18_ACCELERATION_REFERENCE.definition: Closed H4 RCI18 delta1 >= rolling 75th percentile of the latest 100 closed H4 bars.

walk_forward_health_gate.reason: Resolved-only rolling PF gates can reduce DD but parameter selection is sensitive to lookback length and threshold. The adaptive market-state candidates above are simpler and currently preferred.

research_decision: Keep SHORT out of the main candidate stack for now.
Carry N1 and N2 as the simplest adaptive LONG building blocks.
Treat N3 BROAD CORE as the leading frequency-oriented research candidate, not a live rule.
Treat N4 PREMIUM as a high-quality but low-frequency reference only until fresh evidence exists.
Do not change M7C or reset M8C.
